summary: Solid core coverage with good separation of concerns (labeler, CLI, workflow structure). Happy path is well-tested. Key gaps: (1) edge cases like empty rules array, special characters in paths, and Windows paths are untested; (2) error scenarios for invalid glob patterns not covered; (3) act integration tests limited to 3 representative cases instead of comprehensive coverage; (4) task requirement 'every single test case must execute through act' is not fully met—most tests run directly, bypassing the workflow. Would catch regressions in core labeling logic and workflow references, but miss edge cases and error paths not explicitly tested.
